finding.title: The email addresses are hard-coded, which can be a security risk if the code is shared or exposed.
The password is read from a file in plain text. It should be stored in an encrypted format.
The password is transmitted in plain text over the network. It should be transmitted securely.
The password is read from a file, but the file itself is hard-coded, which can be a security risk if the file path is predictable.
